repository.orgName: Bibliothèque nationale de France. Département des Manuscrits

summary.p: An incomplete Tivākaram: chapter 1 only, that is, the Teyvappeyarttokuti ("section on the names of gods").
By a Christian copiyst (see Christian crosses, Christian blessing, and Christian invocation, that is, a Christianized version of the traditional invocation of the Tivākaram).
Description based on the examination of the original manuscript (November 2021).
Dimensions assessed at the time of examination.

extent.note: The leaves are broader in their middle than at their edges.

collation.desc: the front cover. Shelfmark on recto.
1 folio = Front Matter (title and invocation). No foliation. Shelfmark on recto. Verso blank. 410 x 25 mm.

26 folios = Tivākaram: Teyvappeyarttokuti. Tamil foliation [1]-26. 2-5 columns. No soot for f4-f25. f26r: light soot; foliation 27 corrected to 26. f26v more dark = original outside page. User Arabic foliation 27 added in black ink on f26v. 410 x 25 mm.

supportDesc.condition: Very good state of preservation, despite some boreholes.

layoutDesc.layout: Aṭi-wise distribution (1 aṭi per line) for the invocation (U1). Final letter(s) occasionally indented at the end of line (U2).

additions.desc: BnF shelfmark sticker: INDIEN 240 (front cover, recto).
Shelfmark in black ink: N° 6 bis (f[1]r). This appears to be the number in Velanguani Arokium's catalogue (f. 2v, nos. 6, 21).

binding.p: Pinewood covers apparently fabricated in the BnF. 410 x 25 mm.

origin.origDate: No internal date. Not dated by Vinson in Vinson et al. (1866-) nor by Cabaton (1912). Not after 1845, since apparently described in Velanguani Arokium's catalogue (1845).

listBibl.bibl: Cabaton, Antoine. 1912. Catalogue sommaire des manuscrits indiens, indo-chinois et malayo-polynésiens. Bibliothèque nationale. Département des manuscrits. Paris: E. Leroux. — See p. 38, nos. 240-242.
James, Gregory. 2000. Colporuḷ: A History of Tamil Dictionaries. 1st edition. Chennai: Cre-A. — See p. 62ff., 704.
Vinson, Julien & Feer, Léon & s.n. 1866-. Catalogue des manuscrits tamoul et télinga. Manuscript, BnF Indien 577. — See f. 56r, no. 224240.
Velanguani Arokium [Vēḷāṅkaṇṇi Ārōkkiyam]. 1845. Catalogue des manuscrits tamouls de la Bibliothèque royale. BnF NAF 5443. — See f. 2v, nos. 6, 21.

encodingDesc.p: General ― Unmarked length of ō and ē supplied. Unmarked puḷḷi supplied. Conjectural reading (text unclear) between parentheses. Supplied reading (text lost) between square brackets. Alternative readings separated by slash. In transliteration ― Unmarked elided overshort u supplied as an apostrophe. Uppercase for initial vowels. Symbols between curly brackets. Abbreviations ― c = column; f = folio; lf = library foliation; lm = left margin; r = recto; rm = right margin; u / U followed by a number = unit (codicological and/or textual); v = verso.
